name: ElectricityLoadDiagrams20112014
description: The ElectricityLoadDiagrams20112014 dataset contains 15-minute electricity consumption measurements in kW for 370 Portuguese clients between 2011 and 2014. Spanning 140,256 time steps per client, it is a classic multi-client multivariate benchmark for evaluating deep learning and regression models on energy forecasting.
